page_notes.716: 8-Hole Pressure Manifold Stopper Plate (9-18): 15-series rows 2163 and 2163-Black extracted; 10-series 2448 rows skipped; Included Hardware 3119 attached as suggested_hardware; required machining (Tap Profile End, p.11-3) has no service number, recorded in notes.
page_notes.717: Pressure Manifold Access Plate (9-19): 15-series 2440/2441 Clear and Black extracted; 10-series 2439 and metric 25-/40- rows skipped. O-Ring for Pressure Manifold: 15-series 2156 extracted; 2157 (10) and metric rows skipped. Material/hardware/machining for access plates taken from page 9-20 per the page footnote.
page_notes.718: Pressure Manifold Tap Ready Access Plate (9-20): 15-series 2450 and 2450-Black extracted; 10-series 2451 and metric rows skipped; 15-series Included Hardware (3119 + 3278) attached; required machining Manifold Access Profile Milling (p.11-21) has no service number, recorded in notes.
page_notes.719: Tower Lights & Bracket (9-21): 21003, 21004, 20005 extracted (merged series cell includes 15); 15-series suggested hardware (11-5516 + 13023) attached; Compatible Accessories table (20030, 20300, 20450, 20900, 20002, 20004) has no series badges and is recorded in notes only.
page_notes.720: Andon Light Assembly (9-22): 21013 and 21014 extracted (merged series cell includes 15); 15-series suggested hardware (11-6316 + 13024) attached; Compatible Accessories recorded in notes only.
page_notes.721: LED Task Light (9-23): 21057 and 21130 extracted (merged series cell includes 15); 15-series suggested hardware (11-6312 + 3836) attached; Compatible Accessories recorded in notes only.
page_notes.722: LED Task Light with Dimmer (9-24): 21055 extracted (series badges include 15); 15-series suggested hardware (11-6312 + 40-1961) attached; Compatible Accessories recorded in notes only.
page_notes.723: Color and White LED Rope Lights (9-25): 21060, 21120, 21200, 21906, 21912, 21920 extracted (merged series cell includes 15); Compatible Accessories (incl. 20003, 20010) and controller 20001 recorded in notes only; no suggested hardware table.

remaining_doubts: 9-20 Included Hardware prints the 15-series bolt 3119 as "5-16/18 x 7/8” SHCS" (kept verbatim on 2440/2441/2450); 9-18 prints the same part as 5/16-18 x 7/8” SHCS, so 9-20 is likely a typo.
9-20 feature text "mounds to profile side" kept verbatim (likely 'mounts').
2440/2441 material, finish, process, required machining and included hardware come from page 9-20 via the 9-19 footnote, not from the 9-19 table itself.

Light products on 9-21 to 9-25 are badged with a shared 10/15/metric series cell; only the 15 badge is recorded. Suggested-hardware T-nut descriptions add the word 'T-Nut' to the printed description for clarity.
Compatible Accessories rows (20030, 20300, 20450, 20900, 20002, 20004, 20003, 20010) and controller 20001 carry no series badge and are recorded only in notes, not as parts.
